strategy.channel_positioning: ExamCrackerAI — high-utility exam concepts turned into visually memorable 20-35 second explainers, with search-led packaging and original premium thumbnail art.
strategy.selection: Exam-only + viral-content gate. Select topics that combine strong search intent with a curiosity gap, contrast/common-mistake angle, concrete mechanism, visual payoff, and an exam-useful takeaway. Reject plain definitions, broad overviews, generic facts, and low-curiosity titles.
strategy.script: 45-65 spoken words target with a complete curiosity loop: surprising hook → specific setup → mechanism → one concrete example → exam trap/payoff. No fake urgency, generic A/B games, countdown filler, or empty CTA narration.
strategy.thumbnail: AI hero art first (Cloudflare FLUX; FLUX.2 klein for thumbnails), then original Pillow typography and graphic accents. 10 archetypes, three candidates, automatic visual scoring, 1280×720 output.
strategy.creative_engine: V17 information design: AI artwork + deterministic teaching cards; strong topic-specific first frame; three visual modes (concept, worked_example, exam_card); deterministic scene-family continuity; no generic subtitle-fragment headlines.

bank_it_officer.system_prompt: Create a high-value 25-40 second educational Short for Indian bank IT-officer aspirants. Teach one precise concept. Start with a concrete misconception, contradiction, or practical consequence. Explain the rule in plain English, show one worked example or visual mechanism, then end with a one-line exam takeaway. No A/B choices, no countdown, no fake percentages, no generic motivational filler.

Banker Algorithm: the safe-state shortcut exam options hide
OSI Layer 3 vs Layer 4: the routing vs delivery trap
Subnetting: find usable hosts fast without writing binary
RSA vs AES: why one encrypts keys and the other encrypts data
ACID isolation: why two users can see different transaction results
Primary vs candidate vs unique key: the NULL trap
Firewall vs IDS vs IPS: which one reacts first to the same attack
